Summary: The Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) Employment Situation for April 2026 is scheduled for release on Friday, May 8, 2026, at 08:30 AM Eastern Time, according to the BLS release calendar and the finance calendar. The April 2026 report showed job gains of 115,000, above the consensus forecast of 55,000, with the unemployment rate unchanged at 4.3 percent. The first estimate for any month is built on incomplete returns, typically from around two thirds of surveyed employers, and the BLS revises each month’s payroll figure twice in the following two reports.
